task:
This successor corrects the operator execution envelope, preserving the original diagnostic acceptance outcome. Construction must now ONLY maintain the existing GTL context pin using the available ABG-produced partial compiled Product module and inspect the existing diagnostics/tests. Do not run build/tests or write generated outputs during Construction; Testing owns the declared commands in its isolated snapshot. Preserve the Product source/test edits unless reporting an actual defect; report any required further source repair as a gap. Measure digest, byteCount and renderer span from build/code/src/product/worksite_command_execution.js; do not trust values in the prior report. Do not change the renderer policy or Program behavior. The Testing snapshot now explicitly carries the full tenant code, scripts, support/fixture inputs, package metadata and immutable RC1 contract seeds. Its first two declared commands copy the fixed offline dependency toolchain and immutable contract seeds into writable locations, then run the same build and test obligations. Those copies are input materialization, not generated outcome credit. Read roots cover all native write roots. The original unsafe command TMPDIR stays removed. All prior failed Runs remain failures. No full-product qualification or release claim; the later qualification inventory is still deferred.

Complete the existing RC2 diagnostic repair, including the exact dependent context-pin maintenance exposed by the prior run. The current source/test edits were made by ABG but are unaccepted; inspect and preserve them if correct, do not claim prior completion or fabricate producer credit. The original diagnostic behavior, TypeError class, all guards, accepted configurations and public contract keys remain fixed. The GTL declaration code/src/gtl/worksite_command_execution.ts may change only the digest, byteCount and source span coordinates needed to bind the actual rebuilt Product source. Measure them from the compiled bytes; preserve the renderer policy text and span meaning, Program/GraphFunction behavior, schemas and all guards. This is existing identity maintenance, not a new contract. Owner-generated build/, contracts/, product-toolchain-manifest.json and test_env/test_runs outputs may be regenerated by the declared commands. Restore the missing generated outputs by successful owner build, not by inventing files or weakening the generator. No full qualification or release claim: the expected-output qualification inventory remains for the later RC2 cut and is outside this task. Reuse the supplied specification/design. Do not repeat planning stages or rerun Construction just to report an already-known scope gap. Construction's own checks are not Testing/UAT acceptance. The declared test commands now include the repository's VM-module flag and serialize the owner test lane; all original pass predicates remain. The unsafe command TMPDIR override has been removed, so child commands use the platform temporary directory rather than exposing the original workspace root. Retain any new failure truthfully.

Original requested behavior: Repair the existing C2 worksite-command configuration diagnostic in ABIogenesis RC2 using the installed RC1 default lifecycle. The constructor currently reports that command and predicate identities must be unique for many different invalid configurations. Preserve its validation/refusal behavior, TypeError class, public contracts, accepted configurations and all current guards. Make duplicate command identities distinguishable from a protected subject overlapping an allowed write territory, with truthful human-readable diagnostics. Add two focused tests in the existing worksite-command test file, with test names beginning "C2 RC2 diagnostic", that exercise those actual distinct failures and check TypeError and meaningful different cause messages. Preserve existing tests. Do not implement a new error class, public contract field, runtime, controller, or broader refactor. Reuse the existing fixture and accepted Product invariants. Source construction must be performed by ABG, not by the external operator. The operator has supplied task/rubric and a frozen RC1 source checkout, not a solution. The optional task note may record reuse of existing specification/design and the bounded change; do not rewrite Product/requirements or manufacture additional stage obligations. Run the declared owner build and focused test commands, and retain failing/incomplete outcomes truthfully.

Operator execution limits for this declared plan: offline dependency copy 60 s, contract-seed copy 30 s, build 120 s, focused tests 30 s, owner tests 300 s; each retains 5 s termination grace. These finite limits are sized against observed build/test windows. The native enclosing inactivity/absolute limits are 900/1200 s so the complete C2 cleanup budget fits. Every pass predicate remains unchanged.
